# Better Crosshair

A simple and vanilla-friendly resource pack that upgrades Minecraft's default crosshair with a cleaner, sharper, and more polished design.

## Features
- Clean and modern crosshair
- Improved visibility in all environments
- Vanilla-style appearance
- Sharp and crisp pixels
- Compatible with most resource packs
- Great for PvP, Survival, and Building

Whether you're fighting mobs, placing blocks, or exploring the world, Better Crosshair makes aiming feel more precise while staying true to Minecraft's original look and feel.
